$comment: Read by .github/workflows/dependency-update.yml and by the repair agent (dependency-agent.md). `projects` lists every npm project the monthly update covers; each `validate` mirrors what that project's PR workflow runs. The two lib/**/tests projects are deliberately absent: they are gated by pr-rust.yml behind a wasm-pack build and belong to the Rust update. `holdMajors` names dependency majors the agent must NOT take, with the reason; anything else out of range is fair game for it.

projects.validate: npm run build:react && DOWNLOAD_PEWPEW=true NODE_ENV=test npm test
npm run linterror && NODE_ENV=test npm test && npm run build

holdMajors.expect-webdriverio: webdriverio 9 pins the expect-webdriverio peer range; v7 breaks the wdio suite
holdMajors.cookie: other dependents require the old major and an override breaks them
